correction_rationale: In Phase 7C.2R4P4-R2B, RECTIFIED_SEAM_EDGE_DISCONTINUITY_P95 improved by +60.34% (360.80 -> 143.09 px), decisively PASSING the required >= 25.0% threshold. Only RECTIFIED_VERTICAL_LINE_DEVIATION_P95 regressed by -33.12% (12.88 -> 17.14 px). Therefore, seam discontinuity is NOT the failed acceptance metric. Labeling the failure as SEAM_OWNERSHIP_STRUCTURAL_CONSTRAINT before isolating vertical root cause was premature.
